tts: This program asks two questions, one inside the other. First: is the weight sensible? Then: is the patient a child?
The comment says what the program does, and that it is only for learning.
age stores eight.
weight stores twenty-four, in kilograms.
The outer if checks that the weight is more than zero. Twenty-four is, so Python enters the outer block.
Inside it, the inner if asks: is age less than twelve? Eight is, so Python enters the inner block.
dose is fifteen times twenty-four, which is three hundred and sixty.
print shows the child dose.
This else has four spaces, so it belongs to the inner if. The inner if was True, so it is skipped.
This else is at the left edge, so it belongs to the outer if. That was True too, so this is skipped, and the program ends.
